info.name: NasaFlameFreefall - Auditor gateway
info.description: Test the Auditor gateway across machines. Set `base_url` (the Auditor PC's address, for example http://100.64.0.1:8000) and `api_key` in the environment. Run folder 'Calculator -> Auditor' top to bottom, or any request on its own. Sample findings are real: F-001 and a tampered copy.

request.description: No key needed. 'degraded' means Ollama, the model, DuckDB or the PSI tables are missing.
Stores the finding and audits it with Gemma (C8). Answers 200 with the grade, or 202 with a job_id if it takes over 30 s.
use_model=false: C0-C7 and C9 only. C8 stays 'fail' for manual review. reaudit=true audits again even if this exact finding already has an audit.
F-001 with psi25_o2_max changed to 25.0 (the table says 22.2). Expect grade 'rejected', failed C3, send_back_to 04_calcular.

exec: pm.test('200: rejected is a result, not an error', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Poll a 202 answer. 202 again = still running. Unknown id = 404 (the gateway forgets jobs on restart).
Stored findings with grade and failed checks. Rejected ones are hidden (rejected_not_shown counts them).

exec: pm.test('no rejected finding shown', () => pm.expect(b.findings.map(f => f.grade)).to.not.include('rejected'));

request.description: Includes rejected findings, for the team (never for the public view).
One finding with its grade. grade 'pending audit' with stale_audit=true means the stored version has no audit yet.
Grade, failed checks, version and SHA-256 of every stored finding. The Chatbot PC matches finding_sha256 against its own copy.
The full audit: checks C0-C9 with details, recalculation, text review, model and parameters.
